metadata.description: ringringring: your AI agent calls your phone for a two-way voice conversation over free SIP (Linphone). No Docker.

plugins.name: ringringring
plugins.description: Two-way voice calls from Claude Code to your phone over free SIP (Linphone). Swappable STT and TTS.

plugins.name: ringringring-inbound
plugins.description: Incoming calls (the user dials in, the agent answers), dial-back from the same account, optional quiet listening, and an HTTPS remote MCP with OAuth. Needs the ringringring native install.
